integrated_decisions.A_role: Default/fallback when B is absent and cannot justify acquisition, when memory lease is unavailable, or when outside the validated domain.
integrated_decisions.B_create_primary: Create exact EXEC148 with P1 GPU in-place only when the representation is absent, a 549,527,552-byte residency lease is granted, no external acquisition veto applies, and expected same-image reuse reaches the strict workload threshold.
integrated_decisions.B_retention: Once valid B is resident, acquisition cost is sunk. Keep and use B for any positive future reuse while the residency lease remains granted.
integrated_decisions.B_eviction: Evict on memory-lease revocation, model/representation invalidation, execution-path invalidation, correctness identity failure, model unload, or known zero future reuse.
integrated_decisions.no_idle_TTL: No evidence-based time TTL exists; none is introduced.
integrated_decisions.P3_cold: Secondary acquisition path only if P1 is unavailable/vetoed and H reaches 15 W-S / 33 W-C tokens.
integrated_decisions.P0_cpu: Tertiary proven acquisition reference if P1/P3-cold are unavailable and H reaches 17 W-S / 37 W-C tokens.
integrated_decisions.P3_warm: Disabled for the current acquisition-improvement policy.

key_architecture_result.name: SUNK_ACQUISITION_HYSTERESIS
key_architecture_result.statement: Creation and retention use different gates. Crossover thresholds apply only before B exists; after acquisition, do not fall back to A merely because remaining H falls below the creation threshold.
key_architecture_result.benefit: Prevents A↔B thrash and avoids double-counting acquisition cost.

memory_pressure_result.why_no_numeric_pressure_threshold: The resident bytes are measured, but the opportunity cost of memory pressure is not. A universal free-memory threshold would be invented rather than evidence-derived.

lower_level_research_policy.exact_reopen_rule: A lower-level placement study must name a current policy state and show how plausible evidence could flip its route, retention, eviction, or acquisition-path decision.
examples_that_can_reopen: A new creator that lowers acquisition enough to make B win at a horizon currently routed to A.
A memory placement that changes whether the 549,527,552-byte lease can remain granted.
A fallback path that preserves B availability when P1 is unavailable at lower valid total cost.
examples_that_do_not_reopen: Faster microbenchmark with no route flip.
Unused NPU/DSP capacity without exact data path.
Additional mechanism attribution that does not alter selection/lifetime policy.
